findings.before: Installing a custom global bus before first Emit was overwritten by sync.Once initialization, dropping its registered handler.
findings.fix: Lazy atomic compare-and-swap preserves an already configured bus.

findings.before: Concurrent SetGlobalEventBus and Emit produced race-detector failures on the singleton pointer.
findings.fix: Publish and load the pointer atomically; per-bus handler locking remains unchanged.

invariants_checked: Sync/async delivery, handler registration/removal snapshots, metadata cloning and panic recovery
Startup configuration logging avoids secret values; environment/TLS selectors
Shutdown budget/timeout behavior at operational durations; startup timestamp initialization
Error HTTP/status mappings and stable parse error constants

evidence.result: handler loss assertion and data races reproduced
passed; errors package has no test files

limitations: The global bus defect affects custom installation/replacement; current application normally uses default initialization.
